Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
**THE RECORD BREAKER**

FADE IN:

INT. WORLD RECORD OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and camera crews. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JASPER JENKINS, a frail but determined man with a twinkle in his eye. He is escorted to a podium, where a plaque awaits him.

OFFICIAL
Ladies And Gentlemen, Please Welcome The Newest Record Holder: Jasper Jenkins, The Oldest Human To Ever Live!

The room erupts in applause as Jasper is presented with the certificate and a bouquet of flowers. He smiles, his eyes shining with pride.

CUT TO:

INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jasper lies in bed, surrounded by photos and mementos from his long life. He gazes up at the ceiling, lost in thought. Suddenly, his eyes land on a dusty old book on his nightstand.

JASPER
(whispering to himself)
Quantum Immortality...

He begins to read from the book, his voice barely above a whisper.

JASPER
(reading)
"The Many-Worlds Interpretation of Quantum Mechanics suggests that every time a decision is made, the universe splits into multiple parallel universes, each with a different outcome. It's possible that I've lived multiple lives, that I'm not just one person, but a multitude of selves, existing in parallel dimensions..."

As Jasper reads on, his expression changes from curiosity to concern. He starts to feel a creeping sense of dread.

JASPER
(whispering)
What if I'm not just one person? What if I'm a multitude of selves, trapped in a never-ending cycle of birth and death?

Jasper's eyes widen as the implications sink in. He begins to rock back and forth in bed, his mind racing with the possibilities.

JASPER
(whispering)
What if I'm not just a record holder, but a prisoner of my own existence? What if I'm doomed to repeat the same cycle forever?

The camera zooms in on Jasper's face, his eyes wild with fear. He starts to laugh maniacally, his body shaking with the weight of his own mortality.

JASPER
(whispering)
I'm not just 127 years old, I'm a universe unto myself. And I'm trapped in this tiny, insignificant body, forever doomed to repeat the same cycle of life and death.

The camera zooms out as Jasper's laughter grows louder, his body convulsing with the weight of his own existential crisis. The screen fades to black as the sound of Jasper's maniacal laughter echoes on.

FADE OUT.
